Translation is rotated into native slide coordinates by current yaw minus initial yaw; yaw is added to the current native hinge coordinate. No dz or rotation_delta argument. Per SDK call sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy) <=0.20m and abs(dyaw) <=0.30rad. There is no separate cumulative base distance/yaw budget; all base calls share the total SDK-call, control-step and time budgets below. Never bypass clearance, collision, drift or settling checks. sensors.get_observation() does not expose base pose keys.
